subject: GenVault demo time crunch — coverage options

Subject: GenVault: walkthrough this Thu 11/30 11:00 PT — confirm?

Hi Samir / Ava —

Thanks for making time. Per our call, I've provisionally booked a 60-minute demo for Thursday 11/30 at 11:00 PT to walk through model routing, latency profiles, and a short Q&A. Laura (SE) will lead the technical portion.

Agenda attached (Redwood_GenVault_Agenda.pdf). Please confirm the time works or share two alternate 1-hour windows this week.

If anything changes, we'll adapt — just want to ensure we lock a slot that suits your engineering team.

Best,
Karthik

attachments: Redwood_GenVault_Agenda.pdf (PDF)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: GenVault: walkthrough this Thu 11/30 11:00 PT — confirm?

Karthik —

Heads up: I just got travel confirmation for an on-site the morning of 11/30. My flight doesn't land until 10:50 PT and I won't be able to take the 11:00 slot.

Options I can do:
- Shift the demo to 12:30 PT same day (I can make that work)
- Swap in Marissa to lead at 11:00 PT (she's briefed and can handle the walkthrough)
- Compress to a 30-minute focused session at 11:00 PT where I join asynchronously for Q&A via chat after I land

I'd lean toward swapping Marissa for the 11:00 slot to avoid moving your prospect, but happy to align on what reduces friction for GenVault.

Laura
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: SE-travel-itinerary.pdf (PDF)

Subject: Re: GenVault: walkthrough this Thu 11/30 11:00 PT — confirm?

Thanks Karthik / Laura —

11:00 PT is tight for our lead engineer (on a deploy window). Would 11:45–12:15 PT work for a condensed walk-through? If not, 12:30 PT is fine but we have two execs who need to jump onto another call at 13:00.

If Marissa can do 11:00 and make it a 30–40 min focused demo, that would also work — but we prefer the later 11:45 slot if possible.

Samir
Head of Integrations, GenVault
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Samir —

Thanks for the quick reply. Two clear paths here:
1) Move to 11:45–12:15 PT (30 minutes) — Laura can jump on for the first 10 minutes after she lands and Marissa will cover the core demo.
2) Keep 11:00 PT, make it a 30–40 minute focused session with Marissa leading, Laura on standby asynchronously.

Given your team preference for 11:45, let's do option 1. I'll update the invite and attach a shorter agenda.

Marissa — can you lead the 11:45–12:15 slot? I'll send updated invite (genvault-demo-invite.ics) and shortened agenda.

Karthik

All —

Confirmed: I've updated the calendar to 11:45–12:15 PT (invite attached). I'll run a focused 30-minute demo covering routing, latency SLOs, and the two integration patterns Samir called out. Laura, I appreciate you joining briefly after landing for the Q&A—no need to stay the whole time.

Attached: genvault-demo-invite.ics (Calendar invite), Redwood_GenVault_Agenda_short.pdf (PDF)

See you Thursday — I'll prepare a 3-slide appendix for the execs with quick ROI bullets in case they need to dip in/out.
